gloss: the most successful one (of a group)

definitions.gloss: the most successful one (of a group)
definitions.explanation: The person who has risen highest in the world among a group that started out together: classmates, people who joined a company in the same year, or the members of a family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}だ。
examples.english: He has done best of everyone who joined the company with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother is said to be the most successful member of the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧や⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧だ。
examples.english: Of my high-school classmates, the one who has done best is now president of a big company.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧ (rising in the world) and {頭|かしら} (head, leader), read がしら in the compound. The group is named with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}: the star of one's intake
- ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出世頭|しゅっせがしら}: the most successful of one's class
- {出世頭|しゅっせがしら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the most successful
